messages:
kevin_harrison: quick ops check — last night's marketplace rollout flagged a CUDA kernel regression on P4/RTX backends. need to align on pin + hotfix timeline. who can own the partner notif?

maria_gonzalez: saw the alert. reproducing locally now, appears only with cuda 12.2 + our quant kernel. logs attached.

jin_choi: tagging @nvidia_eng to confirm whether the 12.2.1 micro release is expected to fix the memcpy reorder issue. fallback plan: pin to 12.1 for affected AMIs.

nvidia_eng: thanks for the ping — we have a micro patch rolling (12.2.1-rc3) that targets the memcpy reorder. can you share a small repro?

kevin_harrison: repro in the S3 bucket: s3://redwood-ci/driver-regressions/1729004444/repro.tar.gz. failing command: `python -m redwood.bench --model gpt-small --dtype int8 --backend cuda`

lucas_petrov: on-prem marketplace images use a pinned driver matrix. proposal: add a temporary channel to pin CUDA to 12.1 + driver 535.x for all marketplace SKUs, mark as 'temp-hotfix' in manifest. we can rollback when NV confirms patch.

maria_gonzalez: +1. also recommend a canary rollout to 5% of Dedicated pools before org-wide push. can we automate canary via the marketplace deployment jobs?

aws_marketplace: we can do a staged image promotion. need a signed build and updated release notes. ETA for promotion pipeline change is ~2 hours if the artifact is ready.

jin_choi: i'll prepare a patched AMI with cuda-12.1 + driver-535 and a manifest tag `hotfix-2024-11-03`. will push to private registry and signal for canary.

nvidia_eng: we appreciate the repro. patch CI shows it fixes the replication in most cases. recommend testing with `--num-batches 8 --seq-len 1024` to be thorough.

kevin_harrison: ops checklist I'm tracking:
- reproduce (maria) ✅
- draft partner comms (maria + kevin)
- canary AMI (jin)
- marketplace promotion (aws_marketplace)
- monitoring hooks + rollback policy (lucas)
- update docs + customer advisory (kevin)

lucas_petrov: monitoring: add an SLI for "kernel-failure-count" and a quick alert if token latency deviates >30% post-deploy. also enable `--runtime-telemetry` on canary only to limit noise.

maria_gonzalez: draft comms: "We're deploying a temporary pin to CUDA 12.1 and driver 535 for affected marketplace images to mitigate a kernel regression observed with CUDA 12.2. This is a short-term change; we'll revert once NVIDIA's micro-release is validated." comments?

nvidia_eng: wording looks good. we'll publish a tech note about the micro-release timeline after internal sign-off.

aws_marketplace: confirm we need signed artifact + updated listing metadata. please attach new manifest and security hash to the PR so we can expedite.

jin_choi: pushing AMI now. build log snippet:
```
[2024-11-03T02:10:12Z] build: ami-0abcd1234
[2024-11-03T02:11:30Z] install: cuda-12.1
[2024-11-03T02:12:45Z] install: nvidia-driver-535.54
[2024-11-03T02:15:00Z] tests: bench-basic PASSED
```

kevin_harrison: great. timeline: canary rollout in 3 hrs, monitor for 6 hrs, then promote if stable. if we see >1% kernel-failure across canary, auto-rollback.

deploy-bot: deployment scheduled: marketplace-hotfix/v1 -> canary group (5%) at 2024-11-03T05:00:00Z. CI run id: 987654321.

maria_gonzalez: I'll send partner advisory after canary goes green. tagging legal for the advisory copy review.

lucas_petrov: one more ops note — add a short-lived env flag in infra: `REDWOOD_DRIVER_PIN=12.1` so we can toggle without re-building images if needed.

kevin_harrison: good call. jin, can you make the AMI builder accept that override?

jin_choi: yes, done. builder now reads `REDWOOD_DRIVER_PIN` from env and falls back to manifest if unset. pushed to repo. PR: github.com/redwood/ami-builder/pull/1123

maria_gonzalez: thanks all. i'll update thread with canary results. :thumbsup:

kevin_harrison: thanks team — big help. we'll sync with partners after canary and the NV micro-release confirmation.
